title: MC$^2$: Monte Carlo Correction for Fast Elliptic PDE Solving
abstract: arXiv:2605.09288v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Partial differential equation (PDE) solvers underpin modern computer graphics, geometry processing, and scientific computing. Classical Monte Carlo PDE solvers such as Walk-on-Spheres (WoS) provide mesh-free estimations that are unbiased, but with accuracy limited by sampling and numerical approximation. Learned solvers are fast but biased and brittle under distribution shift. We therefore present MC$^2$, a hybrid Neural Network-Monte Carlo PDE solver that treats a low-budget Monte Carlo solution as a structured estimator of the true field and learns a single-pass neural correction to recover a high-fidelity solution. MC$^2$ matches the accuracy of solutions using over $1000\times$ more Monte Carlo samples, outperforming all evaluated mesh-free classical, denoising, and neural-operator baselines. translated_title: MC$^2$：面向快速椭圆偏微分方程求解的蒙特卡洛校正方法
translated_abstract: 偏微分方程（PDE）求解器是现代计算机图形学、几何处理和科学计算的基础。经典的蒙特卡洛PDE求解器（如游走球面法WoS）能够提供无偏的无网格估计，但其精度受限于采样数量和数值近似。学习型求解器速度很快，但存在偏差，且在分布偏移下表现脆弱。为此，我们提出了MC$^2$——一种神经网络与蒙特卡洛混合的PDE求解器，它将低预算的蒙特卡洛解视为真实场的结构化估计器，并学习一个单次前向的神经校正来恢复高保真度的解。MC$^2$能够匹配使用超过1000倍蒙特卡洛样本所得解的精度，优于所有被评测的无网格经典方法、去噪方法和神经算子基线。为了支持有限计算资源下PDE求解的可复现研究，我们还发布了PDEZoo——目前最大的标准化椭圆偏微分方程基准数据集。
tldr: MC$^2$通过学习单次神经校正来修正低预算蒙特卡洛PDE解，以少量采样达到超过1000倍样本量的求解精度，并发布了最大规模的标准化椭圆PDE基准数据集PDEZoo。
en_tdlr: MC$^2$ learns a single-pass neural correction on low-budget Monte Carlo PDE solutions, matching the accuracy of solvers using 1000× more samples, and releases PDEZoo, the largest standardized elliptic PDE benchmark.
